# Security policy

Report security vulnerabilities in T3++ privately through
[GitHub's advisory form](https://github.com/Kayyo321/T3-plus-plus/security/advisories/new). Please
do not disclose them publicly until we have had a reasonable opportunity to investigate and
remediate them.

T3++ still uses services operated by T3 Tools, such as the T3 Connect relay and app.t3.codes.
Report vulnerabilities in those services to [security@ping.gg](mailto:security@ping.gg) under their
[security policy](https://t3.codes/security-policy).
